title: Location basic building fields
text:
Location basic building fields

Validation rules related to the basic building characteristics.

Select an exposure view, a contract in the contract list, the 
Contract
 details
 pane, and then the location.

| Field | Description | Validation Rules | Default Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Construction Code
 Type | One of the following types of construction codes to
 indicate the construction code type that you are using for the building and appurtenant (other) structures at this location: Touchstone codes ( Touchstone ) ATC codes (ATC) ISO earthquake codes (ISE) ISO commercial fire codes (ISF) ISO dwelling fire codes RMS Euro codes RMS JPBLDG codes RMS IND (industrial) codes (RMI) RMS codes (RMS) RMS USER codes ISO WC codes (ISW) We always recommends translating non- Touchstone codes to Touchstone codes wherever possible
 before importing your data. Note: If you select a
 non- Touchstone construction
 code type and specify non- Touchstone construction codes in the Construction Building and Construction Other Structures fields, Touchstone displays the non- Touchstone construction codes in
 these fields. Touchstone also
 maps these codes to Touchstone construction codes. Touchstone stores both the non- Touchstone (user-supplied) construction codes that you have specified and the
 corresponding Touchstone construction codes in the exposure database into which you have imported
 or added your locations. | Required if you are creating a new record or editing an existing
 record Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface | Touchstone codes |
| Construction Building | Construction code for the building at this location. The
 construction code type that you have specified determines which codes are
 valid for this field. | Required if you are creating a new record or editing an existing
 record Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface, if
 the construction code type is AIR codes ( AIR ) For offshore platforms, that is, for locations with an offshore country code such as "GOM" (Gulf of Mexico), the only
 valid construction class codes are the offshore
 asset construction class codes . | 100 - Unknown (800 - Unknown for offshore exposures,
 i.e., exposures that use an offshore country code) |
| Construction Other
 Structures | Construction code for any appurtenant structures covered at
 this location. The construction code type that you have specified
 determines which codes are valid for this field. | Optional Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface if
 the construction code type is AIR codes ( AIR ) | 100 - Unknown (800 - Unknown for offshore exposures,
 i.e., exposures that use an offshore country code) |
| Occupancy Code Type | One of the following types of occupancy codes to indicate
 the occupancy code that you are using at this location: Touchstone codes ( Touchstone ) ATC codes (ATC) ISO BOP codes (ISB) ISO COMFAL codes (ISC) ISO codes (ISO) RMS EURO-FR codes RMS EURO codes RMS JPOCC codes RMS IND (industrial) codes (RMI) RMS codes (RMS) RMS WC codes (RWC) SIC codes (SIC) Note: If you select a non- Touchstone occupancy code type and
 specify a non- Touchstone occupancy code in the Occupancy Code field, Touchstone displays the non- Touchstone occupancy codes in these
 fields. Touchstone also maps
 these codes to Touchstone occupancy codes. Touchstone stores both the non- Touchstone (user-supplied) occupancy codes that you have specified and the
 corresponding Touchstone occupancy codes in the exposure database into which you have imported or
 added your locations. | Required if you are creating a new record or editing an existing
 record Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface | Touchstone codes |
| Occupancy Code | Occupancy code for the building at this location The
 occupancy code type that you have specified determines which codes are
 valid for this field. | Required if you are creating a new record or editing an existing
 record Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface if
 the occupancy code type is AIR codes ( AIR ) For offshore platforms, that is, for locations with an offshore
 country code (ISO Country
 Codes , such as "GOM" (Gulf of Mexico), the only valid
 occupancy class codes are the offshore
 asset occupancy class codes . | 311 - General commercial (900 - Unknown for offshore
 exposures, i.e., exposures that use an offshore country code) |
| IsTenant | One of the following values to indicate whether this
 location is covered by a tenant policy: Yes No | Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface | No |
| Year Built | Year in which the building at this location was built or
 underwent a major upgrade. The age of a building provides a good
 indication of the building codes that are in effect for the
 building. When the year built of the structure is not known, Touchstone calculates an
 unknown year built damage function by applying an exposure-weighted
 distribution to the corresponding damage functions for each year
 built. Touchstone uses
 this field for earthquake and hurricane analysis. | Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface Must be a numeric value between 0 and the current year, inclusive.
 For example, if the current year is 2017, you can enter a value
 between 0 and 2017, inclusive. | [NULL] |
| Stories | Number of floors or stories of the risks that this location
 record covers. For pleasure boats , this field represents the boat length in feet.
 Enter a value (in feet) within one of the following categories to specify
 the length of the pleasure boat: Small (up to 26 feet) Medium (26-50 feet) Large (over 50 feet) If the pleasure boat length is unknown, enter 0 . Touchstone does not support this
 field for offshore platform policies. Therefore, enter 0 . | Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface Must be a numeric value between 0 and 999, inclusive. For
 half-stories, we recommend that you round up to the next integer
 before importing. This is because the application only supports
 modeling integers for the Stories field. | [NULL] |
| Gross Area | This field affects losses for: Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States Verisk Earthquake Model for the United States Forestry locations for extra tropical cyclone in Sweden and
 Norway In version 10.0, for the Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States For the United States hurricane and earthquake models, this is the
 Gross Area of the building at this location. Touchstone does not support this
 field for offshore platform policies. Therefore, enter 0 . Click this link for information about: Differences between Gross Area and Floor Area . | Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface Must be a numeric value between 0 and 15000000, inclusive | [NULL] |
| Gross Area Units | One of the following units of measurement for the gross area: Acre (AC) Hectare (HA) Square feet (SQFT) Square meters (SQM) The Gross Area (square footage) for the Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States does not include Finished Attic or
 Finished Basement. | Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface | Square feet |
| ISO Construction Code | ISO construction codes for the building at this
 location. See "ISO Fire Codes" and "ISO Earthquake Codes" in the Help
 provided for non- Touchstone construction class codes in your Touchstone Client. | Optional | |
| ISO Occupancy Code | ISO occupancy code for the building at this location. See
 "ISO Commercial, Fire, and Allied Lines (COMFAL) Codes" in the Help
 provided for non- Touchstone occupancy class codes in your Touchstone client. | Optional | |
| Building Value per Gross Area | Building value per gross area for this location. The
 building value per gross area calculation for each location is the replacement value building divided by the gross
 area. | Read only Not applicable for workers' compensation locations | |
| Territory | User-defined territory code for this location for reporting
 purposes. | Optional Can contain up to 30 characters Can contain hyphens and underscores | |
| Building Height | Height of the building at this location. This field is not
 used for loss calculations; it is used only for informational
 purposes. The building height units that you specify determine the unit
 in which you should express the value for this field. | Optional Defaults to a value in the Touchstone user interface Must be a numeric value between 0 and 2,147,483, 647, inclusive | |
| Building Height Units | One of the following units of measurement for the building height: Feet (FT) Meters (M) | Optional | |
